title: Competitor database
description: data/competitors.json is an array of these. One entry per player found in the four-ring sweep (direct, adjacent up/down-market, non-product substitute, platform that could absorb this). Every entry carries last_verified; an entry older than 30 days is stale and may not be cited without re-verification.

ring.description: Which ring of the sweep found it. 'substitute' = a non-product alternative (agency, freelancer, spreadsheet, doing nothing). 'platform' = an incumbent or general-purpose tool that could ship this as a feature.

segment.description: Free-text market segment label, defined per engagement (e.g. 'prosumer-ai', 'dev-tool', 'enterprise-suite').

target_user.description: Who they sell to, in their own words where possible.

job_done.description: The job the buyer hires them for.

pricing_model.description: e.g. 'subscription per seat', 'per delivered unit', 'metered API', 'one-time', 'free / OSS'.

price_points.description: Actual prices with units, e.g. '$24.90/plan/month (Plus)'. Read off the pricing page this session.

price_evidence_grade.description: PAGE = fetched the vendor page and read it. SNIPPET = a search result quotes it. UNVERIFIED = aggregator only; treat as false until proven.

free_tier.description: What the free tier actually grants, verified. A common source of refuted claims.

output_or_deliverable.description: What the user walks away with.

traction_signals.description: Users, downloads, stars, reviews, dependents — DECOMPOSED where possible, not as headline totals.

trajectory.description: Shipping fast / steady / dormant / retreating. Judge threat_level on this, not on current size. Note last release date.

strengths.description: Written honestly. An entry with no strengths is a tell that the research was performed to reassure.

review_signal.description: What the one-star reviews say. The best free product research available.

threat_rationale.description: Why that level — based on trajectory, not size.

positioning_vs_you.description: One sentence naming the real difference AS A BUYER WOULD EXPERIENCE IT, not as your architecture describes it. Write 'none found' when there is none — that is the most valuable value this field can take.

verdict.description: Does this player's existence refute your central differentiating claim? Answer per competitor, in the file.

watch_trigger.description: The specific observable change that would raise threat_level, and the cadence to check it.

last_verified.description: ISO date. Stale after 30 days. Re-verify the entry your moat depends on FIRST.
